# GitHub configuration

Continuous integration, documentation and release workflows plus contribution templates.

## Contents

- [ISSUE_TEMPLATE/](ISSUE_TEMPLATE/README.md): the ISSUE TEMPLATE subdirectory.
- [dependabot.yml](dependabot.yml): the dependabot file.
- [pull_request_template.md](pull_request_template.md): the form every pull request
  fills.
- [workflows/](workflows/README.md): the workflows subdirectory.

Start with [workflows/README.md](workflows/README.md).
